title: Irish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty, comforting lamb stew with a rich flavor, perfect for a keto diet. This dish is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: 1. Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
4. Add the olives, garlic, and thyme to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
5. Add the stew (broth) to the pot and bring to a boil.
6. Return the lamb to the pot and bring to a simmer.
7. Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
8. Season with salt, pepper, and black pepper to taste.
9. Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
